name: amen-jungle-pirate-tape
style: 1994 UK jungle instrumental, 165 BPM, drums already rolling at bar one with no intro: a frantic chopped and time-stretched Amen breakbeat, ghost snares, stuttering snare rolls, metallic Akai S950 sampler grain on the stretched hits. Rolling mono sine sub bass under the breaks, one stabbing hardcore rave chord punched in on the offbeats. Homemade bedroom-studio mix taped off a London pirate radio broadcast: cassette hiss, saturated and slightly crunchy, wobbly tape, warm distortion on the drums. Raw, rough, working-class, loopable, relentless.
exclude: vocals, MC, rapping, ragga vocal samples, vocal chops, singing, choir, spoken word, piano, slow intro, build-up, riser, ambient pads, polished festival EDM, dubstep wobble, neurofunk, clean modern mastering
